faq_section.label: FAQ
faq_section.title: Frequently asked questions.
faq_section.a1: BARF (Biologically Appropriate Raw Food) is a way of feeding dogs based on raw ingredients — beef mix, organs, bones and supplements. It's based on what dogs ate before domestication.
faq_section.q2: Which breeds does the app support?
faq_section.a2: The app works for all breeds — from Chihuahuas to Saint Bernards. Just enter your dog's breed, age and activity level and the app will calculate the correct daily portions automatically. We support small, medium, large and giant breeds.
faq_section.q3: How is the daily limit calculated?
faq_section.a3: The daily limit is based on the dog's weight and activity — usually 2–3% of body weight per day. The app automatically splits this into four BARF components: muscle, bones, organs and kidneys.
faq_section.a4: Yes, core features — fridge, daily logs and meal mixes — work without an internet connection. Community and recipe sharing require a connection, but your data is always stored locally on your phone.
faq_section.a5: Yes, downloading and basic use is completely free with no hidden fees. We plan premium features for advanced users in the future, but all the main tools — fridge, macros, mixes and community — will stay free forever.
